Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class WikiQueryAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.WikiQueryAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
WikiQueryPort
@Component public class WikiQueryAdapter extends Object implements WikiQueryPort
JPA-backed implementation of WikiQueryPort.

Maps wiki JPA entities to domain records for consumption by the newsletter service and other domain consumers. Phase 1 uses simple LIKE queries for relevance; future phases may upgrade to pgvector semantic similarity.

Source references are loaded from the wiki_source_refs table and mapped to SourceRef domain records. Contradictions are loaded from wiki_contradictions with pipe-delimited article IDs expanded into SourceRef lists (with minimal metadata since the full article is not joined).

      Description copied from interface: WikiQueryPort
      Retrieve contradictions detected since the given timestamp, ordered by detection time (most recent first).
